boundaryContract.cutClosure: Body meshes intentionally open on exact source cuts. Wood cut closure uses camera BSDF / transparent secondary rays. Blue cut closure uses the common native procedural top-radiance field for camera rays and ordinary BSDF for transport. Corners/end members must use the same material roles, radiance model, and boundary profiles.

blueCutRadianceModel.method: One symmetric quartic in q=(localY/.18)^2, fitted to native scene-linear top/coping irradiance. Used only by camera rays on intentional blue cut planes. All non-cut surfaces remain ordinary BSDF. No per-facing coefficients, raster correction, texture card, or geometry extension.
